Rename a user account

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot rename a user that is an organization | validation | ctx.ContextUser.IsOrganization() |
| Rename creates redirect from old name to new name | business_logic | Rename is not capitalization-only |
| Capitalization-only rename skips redirect and directory rename | business_logic | strings.EqualFold(newUserName, u.Name) |

### Error Paths

- **User is organization** → admin.RenameUser → 422
- **Name already exists** → admin.RenameUser → 422
- **Name reserved** → admin.RenameUser → 422
- **Name pattern not allowed** → admin.RenameUser → 422
- **Name chars not allowed** → admin.RenameUser → 422
